intent: Let the Contexts rest on the code that holds them instead of on a document being retired.
observable_outcome: An Agent reading the Run and Registry Contexts sees a responsibility stated by the package that owns it, and no reviewed record depends on the Context Map.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Each Context's responsibility is evidenced by the doc comment of the package that owns it, and its name by the decision that draws the boundaries.
No reviewed record cites the Context Map, the document this Plugin is meant to replace.
The approval that replaces the previous reviewed records names the approval it replaces, and is checkable outside the package.
